verdict.rationale: An official community chatroom is a fair ecosystem question for a UI framework, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an official Discord, chat server, or any other community chatroom for SolidJS. The README excerpts cover only framework features, setup, and the playground, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can join an official community chatroom to get help and connect with other framework users
